sloka: यस्मान्मामवजानीषे नाहुष त्वं दुरात्मवान् ।जरया परया जीर्णः शैथिल्यमुपयास्यसि ।। ७.५८.२३ ॥
transliteration: yasmānmāmavajānīṣe nāhuṣa tvaṁ durātmavān ।jarayā parayā jīrṇaḥ śaithilyamupayāsyasi ।। 7.58.23 ॥

translations.english: Chyavana cursed Nahusha, declaring that because the evil-minded Nahusha disregarded him, he would become extremely worn out by old age and attain great weakness.
